title: anthyllis vulneraria var. maritima
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria var. maritima, commonly known as Sea Kidney Clover, is a variety of the Anthyllis vulneraria plant, which is a type of flowering legume native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can be used to treat various conditions such as wounds, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Anthyllis vulneraria var. maritima include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
